scope: Four completed natural AI simulations in two paired cases, plus one separately labeled counterfactual Sacred-only continuation. Simulated game time is not human play duration or a population-wide average.

setup.simulation: Headless, no render, fixed 60 at time_scale1; real 1/60-second game steps; no bank/actor grants or forced orders. Autosave alone disabled by test autoload, with private preferences.
setup.observer: Costly labor summaries sampled at 5 Hz; actual AI/world steps, damage/deposit events and birth/delivery observations retained. Whole-map stock is audit-only, not fed to policy.

caveats: Farm food is deposited food while current job targets an owned Farm; a reorder can carry previously gathered food, so this is not a harvest-origin ledger.
Finite resource depletion is exact whole-map stock and excludes renewable Farm output, Sacred income, Trader income and starting banks.

Trade gate banks/pressure/recovery sampled every 60 game seconds; accepted queues, births, deliveries and deaths are exact events. These samples do not prove the bank value before every 20-second policy check.

Counterfactual leaves Sacred capture/contest/garrison/income/timer, actual AI and all payments unchanged; only Sacred conclusion callback is suppressed. Natural Town Center defeat remains and could end it before 25 minutes.
All successful completed engine exits must have no diagnostics. Host wall time is recorded separately.

not_run.reason: Canceled by parent to bound time and usage; no third natural candidate result is claimed.

counterfactual.scope: Counterfactual: only Sacred conclusion suppressed; natural Town Center defeat remains. No resource, unit, AI policy or timer changes. This is not a natural match-duration sample.

sample_means.caution: Mean of these two selected paired AI seeds, not a population-wide player-match average.

candidate_runtime_scope: All candidate runs pin 383e0127da8349c4ee42d60d590ebf1350949100. They are not relabeled as measurements of any later allocation hotfix or release revision.
findings: The two selected natural candidate AI cases finished 12:24.88 and 11:57.70, versus 9:03.18 and 8:42.87 baseline. The paired sample mean is 12:11.29, not a population-wide average.
The Hard/Hard continuation first intercepted a Sacred conclusion at 18:43.20. Its 20- and 25-minute observations are post-intervention counterfactual; natural Town Center defeat remained enabled.
At 20 minutes,25.125% food,24.76% wood and22.3% gold remained. At 25 minutes,12.75% food,10.97% wood and20.8% gold remained. Farms stayed active and P0 continued paid troop replacement.
P1 reached 100 population and accumulated 338 seconds at the cap. Its late production slowdown is not evidence of exhausted wood.

No AI Trade Posts, paid Trader queues or deliveries occurred in these runs. Late gold banks remained above the 180 gold trade-investment threshold; gold surplus and absent AI trade adoption remain balance limitations.
